title: A HARDER CROWBAR
why: His note of 2026-10-13: the crowbar needs to do a lot more damage, and three swings should kill a crawler; he had also asked that the crowbar be a viable choice in close combat, think Halo. This is a balance change, allowed since he lifted the balance freeze on 2026-10-02. A crowbar blow (Q) now does 18 damage, up from 6, so a standard crawler at full health (52) survives two swings and dies on the third; it took nine before. A pillager at full health (78) takes five swings, a Crier three, a Sentry nine. A blow from behind is still half as hard again, so a crawler hit in the back goes down in two, and elite machines, with more than double the health, take longer. Only the crowbar changed: the bare-hands punch on the left click is still 6, and the reach, the swing speed and everything the enemies do to you are the same.
now: The crowbar hits three times as hard: three swings now kill a crawler, where it took nine.

edits.replacement: fireWeapon(p,crowbarWep(),p.x+Math.cos(p.face)*100,p.y+Math.sin(p.face)*100,true);   // v26.xx (crowbardmg): the crowbar's own 18, not the bare hands 6
